name: PharmGKB_search_drugs
description: Search for drugs in PharmGKB by name or PharmGKB ID. Returns drug name, ID, and basic metadata.

query.description: Drug name or PharmGKB Chemical ID (e.g., 'warfarin', 'PA452637'). Aliases: drug_name, name, drug.

drug_name.description: Alias for query. Drug name to search (e.g., 'warfarin', 'metformin').

name.description: Alias for query. Drug name to search.

drug.description: Alias for query. Drug name to search.

name: PharmGKB_get_drug_details
description: Get detailed information for a drug using its PharmGKB Chemical ID. Returns structural info, cross-references, and related genes.

name: PharmGKB_search_genes
description: Search for genes in PharmGKB by name, symbol, or ID. Returns PharmGKB Gene ID and basic gene metadata.

query.description: Gene name, symbol, or PharmGKB Accession ID (e.g., 'CYP2D6', 'PA128').

alleleFile.description: PharmGKB's allele-definition file for the gene, when one exists.

alleleFunctionSource.description: Where the allele function assignments come from.

amp.description: Whether the gene is on the AMP (Association for Molecular Pathology) recommended testing list.

buildVersion.description: Which genome build PharmGKB's own record is anchored to.

chrStartPosB38.description: Start coordinate on GRCh38/hg38. Pair it with the B37 fields: a caller that does not know which build a coordinate is on cannot use it.

hasNonStandardHaplotypes.description: Whether PharmGKB records haplotypes outside the star-allele system.

hideHaplotypes.description: PharmGKB's own display flag for haplotypes.

usesStarAlleles.description: Whether the gene is named with star alleles (*1, *2), which changes how a variant must be written.

vipSummary.description: The VIP summary itself, as an object with an id and an HTML body - the curated prose on why the gene matters pharmacogenomically.

vipTier.description: PharmGKB's Very Important Pharmacogene tier, e.g. 'Tier 1'. The tier is how much curated pharmacogenomic evidence stands behind the gene.

cpicGene.description: True when CPIC has published a prescribing guideline for the gene - the strongest signal that it is clinically actionable.

pharmVarGene.description: True when PharmVar curates the gene's star alleles.

strand.description: Strand the gene is on, e.g. 'minus'.

name: PharmGKB_get_gene_details
description: Get detailed information for a gene using its PharmGKB Accession ID. Returns chromosomal location, cross-references, and other metadata.

chrStartPosB38.description: Start coordinate on GRCh38/hg38. Pair it with the B37 fields: a caller that does not know which build a coordinate is on cannot use it.

buildVersion.description: Which genome build PharmGKB's own record is anchored to.

vipTier.description: PharmGKB's Very Important Pharmacogene tier, e.g. 'Tier 1'. The tier is how much curated pharmacogenomic evidence stands behind the gene.

vipSummary.description: The VIP summary itself, as an object with an id and an HTML body - the curated prose on why the gene matters pharmacogenomically.

amp.description: Whether the gene is on the AMP (Association for Molecular Pathology) recommended testing list.

alleleFile.description: PharmGKB's allele-definition file for the gene, when one exists.

alleleFunctionSource.description: Where the allele function assignments come from.

usesStarAlleles.description: Whether the gene is named with star alleles (*1, *2), which changes how a variant must be written.

hasNonStandardHaplotypes.description: Whether PharmGKB records haplotypes outside the star-allele system.

hideHaplotypes.description: PharmGKB's own display flag for haplotypes.

history.description: PharmGKB's change history for the record.

name: PharmGKB_get_clinical_annotations
description: Get clinical annotations showing gene-drug-phenotype relationships. Returns variant-level clinical significance data. Always provide annotation_id — gene_id lookup is not supported by the API and returns an error with guidance.

annotation_id.description: PharmGKB clinical annotation ID (e.g., '1447954390'). Required for reliable results.

gene_id.description: PharmGKB Gene Accession ID (e.g., "PA128"). NOTE: Gene-based lookup is not supported — will return an error with instructions to use annotation_id instead.

gene.description: NOT SUPPORTED: PharmGKB API requires a specific annotation_id (e.g. "1447954390"), not a gene symbol. Browse https://www.pharmgkb.org/clinicalAnnotation to find annotation IDs. For gene-drug dosing use CPIC_list_guidelines instead.

gene_symbol.description: Alias for gene — NOT SUPPORTED. See gene parameter.

allelePhenotypes.description: Per allele, the phenotype PharmGKB records and whether the evidence for it is limited - each with allele, phenotype and limitedEvidence. This is the annotation's actual content: which genotype means what.

relatedAlleles.description: The star alleles the annotation covers, each as a StarAllele with its PharmGKB id and symbol, e.g. 'CYP2D6*1'.

relatedChemicalsLogic.description: How the related chemicals combine, 'Or' or 'And'. Whether the annotation applies to any one of the drugs or to the combination.

location.description: The variant or haplotype the annotation is about, with its genes, genomic position and haplotype detail.

overrideLevel.description: True when a curator set the level of evidence by hand rather than letting the score decide.

scoreDetails.description: The scoring that produced levelOfEvidence, as a JSON string PharmGKB embeds - the per-step scores behind the level. It is a string, not an object: parse it before reading it.

pediatric.description: True when the annotation is specific to paediatric patients.

history.description: PharmGKB's change history for the annotation, each entry with a date and description.

name: PharmGKB_search_variants
description: Search for genetic variants in PharmGKB by rsID or name. Returns variant IDs and associated gene info.

return_schema.description: List of matching PharmGKB genetic variants.

name: PharmGKB_get_dosing_guidelines
description: Get pharmacogenetic dosing guidelines (CPIC/DPWG) from PharmGKB by guideline_id. IMPORTANT: use the 'clinpgxid' field from CPIC_list_guidelines (e.g., 'PA166251454'), NOT the 'pharmgkbid' field — old-format pharmgkbid values (e.g., 'PA166104996') return HTTP 404. The test example PA166251465 is for the warfarin guideline.

guideline_id.description: PharmGKB ClinPGx guideline ID from CPIC_list_guidelines 'clinpgxid' field (e.g., 'PA166251465' for warfarin, 'PA166251454' for opioids/codeine, 'PA166251458' for tamoxifen). Use clinpgxid, NOT pharmgkbid.

gene.description: Gene symbol (e.g., 'CYP2D6'). NOTE: Filtering by gene symbol is unreliable and may return a generic prompt instead of actual guidelines. Use guideline_id instead.

level.description: The guideline's evidence level, e.g. 'A'. Level A means CPIC considers the gene-drug pair actionable; it is the field that decides whether to act.

link.description: The guideline's source record, with its resource and url.

literature.description: The papers behind the guideline, each with its id and title.

pediatric.description: True when the guideline is paediatric-specific.

relatedAnnotations.description: Other PharmGKB annotations for the same pair.

name: PharmGKB_get_drug_label_annotations
description: Get PharmGKB/ClinPGx regulatory drug-label annotations. Listing mode has exact total and recoverable offset pagination; continue with metadata.next_offset. label_id returns one full annotation.

label_id.description: PharmGKB Label Annotation ID (e.g., 'PA166114907' for the FDA bosutinib label). When provided, returns the full single annotation and ignores 'source'/'limit'/'drug_name'.

source.description: Regulatory agency for the listing mode. One of FDA, EMA, HCSC, PMDA. Defaults to FDA. Ignored when label_id is given.

drug_name.description: Filter the listing to annotations whose name mentions this drug (case-insensitive substring match, e.g. 'imatinib'). Ignored when label_id is given.

limit.description: Maximum number of label annotations to return in listing mode (default 50, max 500).

offset.description: Zero-based listing offset. Ignored for label_id lookup.

oneOf.description: A single label annotation object (when label_id is given) or an array of {objCls, id, name} listings.

highlightedLabelLink.description: Filename of the annotated label PDF, e.g. 'Bosutinib_2025_01_15_FDA.pdf'.

history.description: PharmGKB's change history for the annotation.

otherPrescribingGuidance.description: True when the label's guidance is not genotype-based.

pediatric.description: True when the label carries paediatric-specific pharmacogenomic guidance.

pediatricMarkdown.description: The paediatric-specific text, when there is one.

pgxRelated.description: Whether PharmGKB considers the label pharmacogenomics-related at all.

relatedChemicals.description: The drugs the label covers, each with its PharmGKB id and name.

relatedGenes.description: The genes the label mentions, each with its PharmGKB id and symbol.

source.description: Which agency issued the label, e.g. 'FDA', 'EMA', 'Swissmedic'. The same drug has different pharmacogenomic language in different jurisdictions.

summaryMarkdown.description: PharmGKB's summary of the label's pharmacogenomic content, as an object with an HTML body.

testing.description: Whether genetic testing is required, recommended, actionable or informative, as a PharmGKB controlled term. This is the actionable content of a drug-label annotation.

textMarkdown.description: The fuller annotation text, as an object with an HTML body.

name: PharmGKB_get_pathway
description: Get a curated pharmacogenomic pathway from PharmGKB/ClinPGx by pathway ID (e.g., 'PA145011113' = 'Warfarin Pathway, Pharmacokinetics'). Returns name, authors, biopaxLink, and a full HTML description of the pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic pathway. Keyless. Lookup by ID is required (name-based listing is unreliable upstream).

pathway_id.description: PharmGKB Pathway Accession ID (e.g., 'PA145011113' for the Warfarin Pharmacokinetics pathway). Browse https://www.pharmgkb.org/pathways to find IDs.

history.description: PharmGKB's change history for the record.

gpmlLink.description: GPML file, which is the diagram as data rather than a picture - the form that can be computed on.

illustratorLink.description: Editable Illustrator file of the diagram.

pediatric.description: True when the pathway is paediatric-specific.

pharmacodynamic.description: True when it describes what the drug does to the body. The two are different questions and the pathway's id does not say which it answers.

pharmacokinetic.description: True when the pathway describes what the body does to the drug.

summary.description: PharmGKB's prose summary of the pathway, as an object with an HTML body. The only field that explains what the pathway does.

thumbnailLink.description: Small PNG of the same diagram.

name: PharmGKB_get_variant_annotations
description: Get variant-level literature annotations from PharmGKB/ClinPGx, filtered by gene or chemical accession. Returns exact total and recoverable offset pagination; continue with metadata.next_offset.

gene_id.description: PharmGKB Gene Accession ID (e.g., 'PA126' for CYP2C9). Queried via location.genes.accessionId. Provide either gene_id or chemical_id.

chemical_id.description: PharmGKB Chemical/drug Accession ID (e.g., 'PA451906' for warfarin). Queried via relatedChemicals.accessionId. Provide either gene_id or chemical_id.

limit.description: Maximum number of variant annotations to return (default 50, max 500). CYP2C9 alone has over 1000 annotations.

connWords1.description: Connecting phrase PharmGKB uses to render the annotation as a sentence.

description.description: The annotation in the curator's words, e.g. 'Genotyped for rs1799853 and rs1057910. Combined *2/*2, *2/*3 ...'. The only field that says what was actually found.

drugsConnWord.description: Connecting phrase for the drug part of that sentence.

isAssociated.description: Whether the study found an association at all. A variant annotation with isAssociated false is a NEGATIVE result, and without this field it reads like a positive one.

isPlural.description: Whether the rendered sentence should be plural.

location.description: The variant or haplotype, with its genes, genomic position and diplotypes.

polarity.description: Whether the association is in the direction stated or the opposite, as a controlled term. Reverses the meaning of the sentence it belongs to.

populationTerm.description: The population studied, as a PharmGKB controlled term.

score.description: PharmGKB's evidence score for the annotation, e.g. 2.75.

scoreDetails.description: The per-step scores behind 'score', as an object. Lets the score be checked rather than taken.

studyParameters.description: The study's design parameters: cohort sizes, p-values, allele frequencies and the statistical test used.

useForCaScoring.description: Whether this annotation counts toward the clinical-annotation score.
